children: NeoVolta shares fell after quarterly sales dropped and the company's loss widened.
The stock shed 23% to $2.44 in after-hours trading. Through the close, shares were down 4% this year.

The energy storage company said fiscal fourth-quarter revenue slid to $13,500 from $4.8 million the year before. The drop was due to a substantial decline in residential and traditional installer-channel sales following federal tax law changes.

NeoVolta logged a quarterly loss of $11.7 million, compared with $1.6 million a year before. The wider loss was driven by a $3.9 million provision for credit loss and bad debt expenses, as well as $1.1 million in residential inventory obsolescence reserve.
